911

Sixty years of one silhouette. Scroll to walk around it, then repaint it.

One line, roof to tail.

The roof falls in a single curve to the rear deck. It is the shape every 911 has been drawn from.

The engine sits behind you.

A flat-six hangs behind the rear axle, under a ducktail that sets the car's stance from this angle.

Round headlights, still.

Two circles either side of a low hood. The face has barely changed since 1963.
